card.name: Before the next drug in an example list
card.fires_on: Commas, 'as', 'to' or 'and' right after a drug name or 'such'/'for example', where another drug name will follow. Most often in sulfonylurea or diabetes drug lists, and in NSAID lists.

modes.label: List comma after a drug
modes.description: A comma following a drug name inside an example list, just before the next drug.
